text: {"distance_m": 0.7, "reasoning_short": "A 1 mm spot at 5% contrast is too faint to be detected at the 20/20 resolution limit of about 1 arcmin. For small spots, threshold contrast scales roughly with inverse area (Ricco's law). Blackwell-type indoor data put the threshold near 100% contrast at about 1 arcmin, so 5% contrast needs roughly sqrt(20) ≈ 4.5–5 arcmin. 1 mm subtends 5 arcmin (≈1.45e-3 rad) at about 0.7 m, so this is a rough estimate."}
